_README: ONE config file drives the whole tracker (scraper + dashboard). Edit it by hand, or generate it from your CV using docs/cv-to-config-prompt.md. After editing, commit it and re-run the workflows. All matching is case-insensitive substring on the JOB TITLE unless noted.

keywords._comment: A job TITLE is kept if it contains any of these. Use full words; multi-word phrases match as substrings.
keywords._exclude_comment: Titles containing any of these are dropped (junior roles, off-field roles, and government / defense / military / clearance roles).
keywords._fuzzy_comment: Optional fuzzy pre-filter for LinkedIn title matching. When both fuzzy_seniority and fuzzy_domain are non-empty, role_is_relevant() uses these instead of the exact-phrase keywords.include filter. Leave all three empty to use keyword-only matching.

search_terms._comment: Queries sent to the job boards' search boxes. Broader than 'keywords' (which then filters the titles).

locations._comment: LinkedIn needs a geoId (leave blank to let LinkedIn resolve the text). JobSpy-backed boards such as Indeed, Glassdoor, ZipRecruiter, and Google Jobs need a location + country. HiringCafe currently uses its public US SEO route; locations.hiring_cafe is kept for compatibility. The map auto-fits to wherever the jobs are.
locations._linkedin_partitions_comment: Optional. Used by --linkedin-emit-matrix / --linkedin-backfill-partition for parallel backfill. Leave empty to use single-run backfill (--linkedin-backfill).

location_filter._comment: Case-insensitive substrings matched against a job's location text. Used to post-filter boards that don't support geo-scoping at the API level (e.g. the curated direct-ATS sweep). Keep this in sync with your locations.* entries above.

google_jobs._comment: Optional exact Google Jobs queries. Leave empty to auto-build queries from search_terms.google_jobs and locations.google_jobs. If the free JobSpy path is blocked, set SERPAPI_API_KEY or OXYLABS_USERNAME/OXYLABS_PASSWORD as GitHub Actions secrets for an API fallback.

jobspy._comment: Optional. Prefer JOBSPY_PROXIES as a GitHub Actions secret/env var for private proxy credentials. Use only if JobSpy-backed boards are blocked.

hiring_cafe._comment: Uses HiringCafe's public SSR /jobs/<query> pages. max_pages caps SEO pagination per query; the public route currently defaults to United States.

employers._priority_comment: Optional. Companies worth a daily 'priority' digest even on a quiet day (case-insensitive substring match on the company name). Leave [] to disable.
employers._exclude_comment: Optional. Drop roles from these companies even if the title matches (case-insensitive substring). Used here to remove government contracting / defense / military employers.

priority_topics._comment: Optional. Roles touching these get a gold ★ + a 'Priority topics' filter on the dashboard. [name, regex] pairs.
terms: mlops|machine learning engineer|ml engineer|ml platform|model deployment

role_categories._comment: Dashboard 'Role' filter buckets, applied top-to-bottom to each title. [name, regex] pairs.
terms: data engineer|etl|elt|data pipeline|data platform|data infrastructure|databricks|pyspark|big data|dataops|lakehouse
machine learning engineer|\bml engineer|mlops|ai engineer|applied scientist|machine learning operations

notify._comment: Pushover phone alerts (optional; needs PUSHOVER_TOKEN/USER secrets). Notify when a new role is a priority-topic OR scores at/above min_fit.

weekly_digest._comment: Optional weekly Pushover brief. Prefer enabling via the WEEKLY_DIGEST_PUSHOVER repository variable so forks stay quiet by default.
